mandate: C423 — test the price-only RUNLEN: run-length distribution entropy and up/down asymmetry of consecutive return signs stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. Over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns X=r_i[t-W+1..t]: s_k=sign(X_k) in {-1,+1} with zeros dropped; runs = maximal blocks of identical signs; U = lengths of positive runs, D = lengths of negative runs; runlen_ent=-sum_k p_k log p_k over ALL run lengths (up+down pooled); runlen_asym=(mean(U)-mean(D))/(mean(U)+mean(D)); runlen_up_ent/runlen_down_ent = entropy of up/down run-length distributions only. NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in the W-bar span (global across assets), fewer than 2 runs, or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 4 real (runlen_ent_dev, runlen_asym_dev, runlen_up_ent_dev, runlen_down_ent_dev) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W-bar window).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing log-returns X=r_i[t-W+1..t]; s_k=sign(X_k) in {-1,+1} with zeros dropped; runs = maximal blocks of identical signs; U = lengths of positive runs, D = lengths of negative runs; runlen_ent=-sum_k p_k log p_k over all run lengths (up+down pooled); runlen_asym=(mean(U)-mean(D))/(mean(U)+mean(D)); runlen_up_ent/runlen_down_ent = entropy of up/down run-length distributions only.
methodology.signals: runlen_ent/runlen_asym/runlen_up_ent/runlen_down_ent over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.runlen_vectorization_note: return matrix R=(T,10) built once; per asset, sliding_window_view over W-bar windows in bounded chunks; signs with zeros dropped; runs detected via last-nonzero-sign forward fill + run-start marking; per-window run-length histogram (bincount) feeds entropy/asymmetry scalars; global W-bar finiteness gate; validated against brute-force per-window loop with explicit run-length extraction + entropy, maxdiff < 1e-9 in tests.
